We use ReLU activation on all but the final layer, and we use no activation on the final layer. Other GNN architectures tested in this study are introduced in Appendix A . In this section, we describe the modifications to PI-GCN that we incorporate in our GNN model to boost performance. We focus for now on modifying PI-GCN rather than PI-SAGE despite the fact that PI-SAGE was reported to outperform PI-GCN in [ 2 ] . The reason for this is that when testing PI-SAGE , we found that the optimizer’s learning rate values given in [ 2 ] were large enough that the algorithm failed to converge, resulting in a more extensive search of the parameter space that eventually found a better solution than PI-GCN .
